memory_candidates.content: GKWZ 2003 chunk files under ~/Projects/Literature/sources carry no section navigation (--toc is flat); printed page p sits in chunk p+4..p+20 and can be recovered from bare page-number lines (grep -E '^[0-9]{1,3}$'); the index pages (chunks 748-758) give printed pages for every key notion.

TM's box structure on H_F x D is literally a GKWZ product frame (universal x linear); TM strictly extends Log_SU(Z) x S5 via modal_future / box_time_invariant (shift closure of H_F); stab fails Church-Rosser with time so L+ is not a 3D product; published S5-plus-linear negatives (fmp failures GKWZ 5.30/5.32) coexist with decidability (6.60/6.61, HWZ Cor 69).
